XOR Cracker

XOR with any key, brute-force single-byte keys, recover repeating keys by Hamming distance, derive the key from known plaintext (completing keys longer than the crib), and try every word of any context text as a key.

Split view

XOR with a key

Automatic attacks

Single-byte tries all 256 keys. Repeating-key estimates the key length with normalized Hamming distance (2–40), then solves each column as single-byte XOR. Needs a few dozen bytes per key byte.
